summary: Iteration 34 — Verified all 6 new features. Backend pytest 16/16 PASS (AI Bookings Inbox ingest/ack/convert + dismiss-404; Awards catalogue with all 4 AU awards (MA000119/MA000009/MA000003/MA000004) at 11.5% super with >=3 classifications + NZ/UK/US country filter; install/uninstall lifecycle; super-by-award math correct ($345 = 11.5% of $3000); Integrations Hub returns 'Banks (AU)' + 'Payment Terminals' categories with CBA/Westpac/ANZ/NAB/Macquarie/Bendigo/Bankwest + Tyro/Smartpay/Zeller/Square/Verifone/Ingenico/PAX/Adyen/PayPal Zettle; bulk-edit mode='update_many' when only category/cost/gst set, 'per_row' when pricePercentDelta or modifier ops set, both persist correctly; /api/product-images POST/DELETE return 403 without auth, 403 for cashier, 200 for owner; GET requires auth). Frontend: /pos shows pos-header-bar with live clock (12:55:54 PM), date (Fri, Jun 19, 2026), '5/5 devices online', 'Wi-Fi' connection — old 'POS Terminal' title removed; Dine-in shows table-input free-text accepting '12B'; Takeaway shows walk-in-name input accepting 'Alex'; Customer picker still present. /bookings-inbox renders bookings-inbox-page, compose-card opens, AI parse correctly extracts date/time/party/name/phone/notes from 'table for 4 tonight at 7pm under name TestAlex 0412333444 — one gluten free', shows aiSummary + suggestedReply, Book it converts to reservation (res-2c25ab0a shown). /inventory-accounting Super (Awards) tab shows full catalogue table with install/uninstall buttons, Load Payrun + Compute Super work. /integrations both Banks (AU) and Payment Terminals chips filter correctly; Connect dialog opens.

minor.issue: When awardCode is supplied but not installed, endpoint silently falls back to 11.5% with awardName=null. UI cannot detect 'award missing' state to prompt install. Recommend returning a top-level 'unresolvedAwards': ['MA000xxx'] hint.
Hardcoded SEED_AWARDS in routes/awards.py — production deployments will want a sync job that pulls from Fair Work Modern Awards API. Track as P2.

AI parse is best-effort; if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is unset the endpoint returns parsed={date:null, time:null, ...} but still status=200. Consider returning x-ai-parsed-fallback header so UI can warn 'AI unavailable — fields entered manually'.

issues: AI-extracted date for 'tonight at 7pm' resolved to 2023-10-04 (LLM hallucinated past date). Bookings already in db.reservations are still date=2023-10-04 — not blocking but downstream reservation views will skip these. Consider post-processing: if extracted date is in past, set to current/next day.

action_items: OPTIONAL: super-by-award response should expose unresolved/uninstalled award codes so the SuperPanel can prompt 'Install MA000119'.
OPTIONAL: AI parse should clamp 'tonight/tomorrow' relative dates to current date (LLM returning 2023-10-04 for 'tonight'). Add a post-parse rule: if extracted date < today, snap to today.

OPTIONAL: /api/product-images Pydantic body validation runs before auth dependency — returns 422 on missing fields even when caller is anonymous, leaking the schema. Move auth to a top-level Depends so 401/403 fires first.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/awards.py — SEED_AWARDS hourly rates are 'illustrative' per docstring. Owners may rely on these for actual super calcs (which they shouldn't). Add a UI banner: 'Rates are seed values — verify with Fair Work before payroll'.
/app/backend/routes/bookings_inbox.py — LLM uses 'gpt-4o-mini' hardcoded. Consider env var BOOKINGS_INBOX_MODEL so it can be swapped without code change.

/app/backend/routes/products.py bulk-edit — fast path uses update_many but only inspects {category, cost, gst, eightySixed}. If new bulk-editable fields are added the dispatch logic in needs_per_row must be updated; this is fragile. Consider an allowlist of 'flat fields' as a module-level constant.
/api/bookings/inbox/{id}/ack uses 'user' from request body (untrusted); convertToReservation creates reservations under arbitrary names. Use authenticated user instead of body['user'].

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 — bookings inbox ingest/ack/convert/dismiss-404; awards catalogue/install/uninstall/super-by-award; integrations categories; bulk-edit update_many + per_row modes; product-images auth guard for POST/GET/DELETE across anonymous/cashier/owner)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (POS header bar live clock/date/devices/Wi-Fi present, 'POS Terminal' title removed, Dine-in table-input + Takeaway walk-in-name inputs working, customer picker still present, bookings-inbox-page + compose-card render and AI ingest→convert→reservation creates res-* in DB, Super (Awards) tab + catalogue + install/uninstall + Load Payrun + Compute Super all wired, Integrations Hub Banks (AU) and Payment Terminals chips filter correctly and Connect dialog opens)

seed_data_creation: Test created/deleted 3 throwaway products (TEST_iter34_*), 1 throwaway image, 1 inbox item (TEST_iter34_alex) which got converted to a reservation (res-2c25ab0a). The reservation is left in db.reservations — not auto-cleaned. Future tests should filter source='ai-inbox/phone' + customerName='TestAlex' for cleanup if desired. Awards installed/uninstalled idempotently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 iter34 features (cart inputs, POS header bar, AI bookings inbox, Super (Awards) tab, Integrations hub Banks/Terminals, bulk-edit fast path + product-images auth) verified end-to-end. Three minor enhancements remain (non-blocking): (1) super-by-award should hint about uninstalled awards, (2) AI parse should clamp past-dated 'tonight' relative dates, (3) product-images Pydantic validation runs before auth (422 leaks schema to anonymous callers). Test left ~3 reservations from the AI inbox conversions in db.reservations with date=2023-10-04. Backend bookings_inbox endpoint successfully calls emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and returns a real LLM-parsed payload (not the stub fallback) — confirmed from the suggestedReply containing personalised content ('Thank you, TestAlex! ...').
rca of the issue: N/A — feature additions all working. Only nits noted in design_issues + action_items.
